completeness.raw_binary_capture_scope: Remote frozen CPU consumer verified 1,344 binaries/sidecars and actual sampler/metadata joins; this local reviewer checked every report case and its capture bindings, not a second raw PT tensor read.

triton.scope: Read-only report/provenance consistency audit; CPU capture auditor previously verified raw binary joins. No independent raw PT reread or new GPU math execution.

flashinfer.scope: Read-only report/provenance consistency audit; CPU capture auditor previously verified raw binary joins. No independent raw PT reread or new GPU math execution.

triton.scopes: Native launch records four V2/history sources; replay records the five performance manifest files plus two pinned mathematical kernel files. Full maps are intentionally different.

flashinfer.scopes: Native launch records four V2/history sources; replay records the five performance manifest files plus two pinned mathematical kernel files. Full maps are intentionally different.

bias_values.interpretation: Value equality does not make typed backend specializations identical. Captured replay tests actual dtypes in separate fresh interpreters/workspaces.

limits: Review independently checked every JSON case, metric arithmetic, capture identity, history/prefix metadata, invariant flags, complete coverage, immutable source/runtime/helper/reference bindings and exit receipts. It did not recompute FP64 or GPU kernels or reread the raw PT tensors locally.
Each replay resets both backends to the same captured prestate; captured Triton and FlashInfer native histories use independently propagated states. These are different comparisons.
Finite allclose uses atol=0.01 plus rtol=0.01, together with strict global relative L2 below 0.01. A maximum absolute difference above 0.01 alone is not a failed allclose.
The native propagation metrics use the snapshot consumer reference norm; they are diagnostic observations, not an end-to-end acceptance threshold inherited from local kernel replay.

All captures are non-speculative eager pure decode with batch 8 or 1. No padded rows or masked/null requests were executed; captured sentinel slot 0 and one sampled unused page remained unchanged. Other state pool pages were not replayed.
Synthetic storage-gap guards and original tensor strides/pointer modulo alignment were preserved. Original aliasing and absolute addresses were not reconstructed.
Local replay is independent rank-local execution on one device, not a TP2 sequence replay, accuracy evaluation, EOS termination experiment, or timing benchmark.
Full-attention KV was not captured. The observed common GDN prestate and prefill logits are prerequisites, not complete causal proof.
The fixed-history native sampler has 15 backend choice differences. This does not itself establish free-generation model quality or the precise cause of previous truncation.
Incoming A_log and dt_bias requires_grad=true on all 672 actual captures per backend directly supports the detach input-contract rationale for this run, not every model or configuration.
The native host audit retained one possible exit race and strict same-sample ownership REVIEW_REQUIRED. This local numerical review does not clear it.
conclusion: Captured single-update fidelity and mathematical correctness pass for all covered cases. Propagated inputs/states/outputs differ in the native paired run; model-quality equivalence, performance benefit and a full causal root-cause claim remain unsupported by this localization alone.
